read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table and decision log
input: Hazard's MESH75 hail diameter (mm), read as the largest hailstone at the building, 0 to 203.2 mm
not_covered: Outdoor equipment: AC condenser, rooftop units (whether it sits in the profile value is an open question)
out_of_scope: Contents (declared as a withheld placeholder part)
Wind and flooding from the same storm (other cells)
missing_mechanisms: Rain entering after a roof breach

how_to_use.share_of: Each part's own replacement value (roof cover; walls and windows); building share = unit damage x the part's share of structure replacement cost

outputs.single_event: conditional: proposal, not in the runtime index; part and building required
outputs.scenario_dollars: withheld until the building value is qualified
outputs.yearly_loss: withheld before promotion (computed by the consumer afterwards)

conditions: The walls-and-windows unit answers only with the acknowledgement HRE_T4_WALLS_WINDOWS_SCREENING_2026_10_18

method.summary: Published hail-damage thresholds by roofing material (onset and full failure) turned into a replacement probability, times the roof's share of building cost

key_sources: Haag Engineering, hail damage threshold sizes for common roofing (HRE-S001)
Haag Engineering, low-slope roof systems and hail (HRE-S002)
IIBEC, ice-ball impact resistance of heat-aged TPO membranes (HRE-S005)
FEMA, Hazus 7.0 Hurricane Technical Manual, building cost ratios (HRE-S006)
FEMA National Risk Index, Dec 2025 (HRE-S012; check only)
judgment: Hazard's MESH75 size read as the hailstone at the building
Threshold band read as a 5%-95% range
Warehouse roof share 12% of building cost (range 9-15%)
Walls and windows thresholds, exposure and costs (no published thresholds)

checks.name: FEMA National Risk Index: yearly roof loss on Hazard's grid

open_items: Hazard's MESH75 floor (every severe pixel at least 1.5 in) drives most of the gap to NRI
Shingle type and office membrane attachment not in the profiles
Whether outdoor equipment sits in the profile value (for the reviewer)

rows.cost_basis: Hazus roofing 3% x 1.25 = 3.75% of building cost

notes.text: Laminated shingles assumed (3-tab: +42% yearly loss in the NRI check)

rows.shape_basis: Haag onset 2.5 in (T3); full at 3.5 in is judgment (T4)

rows.cost_basis: Hazus roof cover and insulation (1.1% + 0.7%) x 1.25 x 1.20 = 2.7%

notes.text: Mechanically attached membrane assumed (adhered on a cover board: -72% yearly loss)

rows.shape_basis: judgment thresholds for siding and glass
